raw_response:
This plot is only 0.16 ha and is planted to groundnuts and beans intercropped together, not maize. I do not have enough money to buy chemical fertilizer for a small legume plot when my maize field needs it more, but I will spread some cow manure because the animals are nearby and the plot is small. I will use seed I saved from last season, and my children and I can weed and harvest this area ourselves without hiring ganyu labor because the rains will come as usual in Lilongwe.
